BiblicalUsage: I take gᵉzar to mean to cut, determine, nothing more and nothing less. It occurs 6 times, and Daniel shows it doing ordinary work in ordinary sentences. The Bible uses plain words plainly, and this is one of them.
TheologicalSignificance: gᵉzar matters to me because God speaks plainly, and plain words carry real weight. My position is that Scripture does not hide its meaning from honest readers.
RelatedEvents: Nebuchadnezzar's Dream of the Image; Nebuchadnezzar's Humbling
